runtime_gate.reason: Existing canonical F-host shared-runner heartbeat remains stale and height_difference_2 guarded operator recovery remains unexecuted.

score_basis: Non-statistical internal evidence-quality score based on current DEFRA/GLA/Planning Data readback, statutory-vs-strategic nature evidence separation, dataset origin/coverage controls and prevention of BNG or LNRS context being converted to parcel feasibility without baseline geometry and metric evidence.

sources.label: GOV.UK Biodiversity net gain
sources.fact: Statutory BNG framework generally requires at least 10% biodiversity increase relative to pre-development onsite habitat value, subject to exceptions.

sources.label: GOV.UK Understanding biodiversity net gain
sources.fact: Guidance updated 14 July 2026; from 6 August 2026 BNG does not apply to planning applications for developments of 0.2 hectares or below; offsite gains require registration and long-term habitat obligations.

sources.label: GOV.UK BNG guidance for LPAs
sources.fact: Updated 14 July 2026; LPAs must check application information and biodiversity gain plans where BNG applies; exemptions must be handled explicitly.

sources.label: GOV.UK What can count towards BNG
sources.fact: Guidance distinguishes what habitat creation/enhancement can count in full, in part or not at all towards 10% BNG.

sources.label: GOV.UK Legal agreement for BNG
sources.fact: Onsite/offsite gains may require conservation covenant, planning condition or planning obligation and enforcement may apply if agreement terms are not maintained.

sources.label: GOV.UK NSIP BNG collection
sources.fact: BNG becomes mandatory for NSIPs from 2 November 2026; NSIP rules are distinct from ordinary planning-permission BNG rules.

sources.label: London Local Nature Recovery Strategy
sources.fact: London LNRS is a spatial nature-recovery tool; it introduces no new protections/designations and places no obligations on landowners by itself.

sources.label: GOV.UK LNRS areas and responsible authorities
sources.fact: DEFRA identifies LNRS areas and responsible authorities; London is one of the designated strategy regions.

sources.label: Planning Data SSSI
sources.fact: 4,128 SSSIs; collector 23 July 2026; source includes some MHCLG-created data and is being replaced with authoritative source data where needed.

sources.label: Planning Data Ancient woodland
sources.fact: 44,373 ancient woodland records; collector 22 July 2026; origin all authoritative sources.

sources.label: Planning Data Local nature reserve
sources.fact: 1,727 local nature reserves; collector 26 July 2026; dataset contains some MHCLG-created data being replaced with authoritative sources.

sources.label: Planning Data Tree preservation order
sources.fact: 107,674 TPO records from 74 providers; collector/new data 24 July 2026; coverage and origin caveats remain explicit.

examples.result: BNG 10% statutory objective retained as a planning requirement framework, not a predicted parcel cost or approval probability.
6 August 2026 <=0.2ha exemption change tagged FUTURE_EFFECTIVE_DATE; not applied early to 27 July 2026 applications.
London LNRS mapped priority/potential-measure locations treated as strategic nature-recovery evidence only; LNRS itself creates no new designation or landowner obligation.
SSSI dataset origin caveat retained; dataset absence cannot prove absence of protected-site constraints without authoritative-source confirmation.
Ancient woodland dataset is authoritative-origin but still requires exact parcel overlay before any constraint relation.
Local nature reserve dataset mixed-origin caveat retained and no negative proof inferred from incomplete coverage.
TPO dataset provider coverage retained; missing record is not automatically no-tree-protection proof.
BNG legal/metric evidence remains development-specific; no parcel score promotion without baseline habitat geometry, statutory metric and exact relation.
